entities.name: Adam Ważyk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adam Ważyk born Ajzyk Wagman was a Polish poet, essayist and writer born to a Jewish family in Warsaw. In his early career, he was associated with the Kraków avant-garde led by Tadeusz Peiper who published Zwrotnica monthly. Ważyk wrote several collections of poetry in the interwar years. His work during this period focused largely on the losses of World War I. Adam Ważyk was a poets & playwrights from Warsaw (1905-11-17, Warsaw–1982-08-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
